2026-08-27b: SCORER DEFECT (decode_regret tie-break). decode_regret resolves equal surrogate scores by tuple(sorted(plan.items())) -- platform id, unrelated to cost. On a degenerate feasible set the min-marginal surrogate ties the true optimum against worse plans and that arbitrary rule decides the number. Of the control's 16 firing datasets at alpha=2.0, 12 had the true optimum INSIDE the argmin tie set (optimistic == 0 exactly). The scorer docstring's claim that nonzero constrained R_exact 'can be neither a decoder artifact nor an LS fitting artifact' was FALSE and is corrected. Fix is ADDITIVE: decode_regret is byte-identical and r_exact_pct unchanged; a new r_exact_band reports {registered, optimistic, pessimistic, mean_tied, n_tied}. Per SCREEN.md Section 4 mean_tied is the fair reading and optimistic is an upper bound only. NO THRESHOLD MOVED. Commit 2fa4b50.

2026-08-27c: SCORER DEFECT (r_exact denominator). score_corpus summarized r_exact over [not no_feasible_rows and not greedy_stuck]. R_exact is a perfect-decoder bound and the greedy decoder has nothing to do with it. The censoring was NOT neutral: greedy_stuck is perfectly confounded with the replica-config arm -- the control's (n_feasible, stuck) histogram is exactly {(9,False):102, (16,True):101, (16,False):1} -- so one whole cell of the 2x2x3x17 design was dropped from every r_exact statistic and the published 0.1553 was really 'over the 9-feasible-row arm only'. Now three denominators: no_feasible_rows censors everything, greedy_stuck censors ONLY r_greedy, r_exact reads over all feasible datasets. Direction of change on the control @2.0: frac_gt_1pct 0.1553 -> 0.0784 (registered member), i.e. the fix moved the control number DOWN. NO THRESHOLD MOVED. Commit 2fa4b50.
